title: 第12章 夫妻对面

content_zh:
谁知，老太太和王夫人听了王亨的话，喜出望外。
林馨儿还没敬茶呢，就被老太太搂在怀里，百般怜爱，又对众人道：“这小模样，我一瞧就喜欢。”
王夫人也温柔地问林馨儿可习惯，想不想家等等；又说她陪着王亨熬了一晚上，待会回去要补个觉，别累着了；又问她爱吃什么、喜欢玩什么，并叫伺候的人来吩咐：就照少奶奶喜欢的口味去做饮食，少奶奶年纪小，不许拘束她等等。
兄弟姐妹们也围着林馨儿问长问短，很是新奇。
林馨儿自认为有些眼力，怎么看他们都不像虚伪敷衍，个个眼中都充满善意欢笑，心中很是疑惑：难道她运气真有这么好？前世被天妒英才，这辈子老天补偿她了？
王亨很喜悦地显摆道：“祖母，馨儿可聪明了！”
林馨儿想自己现在是孩子，须得率性一些才像，便坦然道：“我在我们村是最聪明的，没想到你更聪明。唉，难过！”
众人愣了下，轰然大笑起来。
老太太搂着林馨儿笑出了眼泪，对王夫人等人道：“看他们小两口和睦，我就放心了。”
王夫人用帕子在眼角轻试了下，感慨道：“老太太说的是。只要他们相亲相爱，我便是即刻去了，也能瞑目了。”
肯定不对！
林馨儿敏锐地嗅到这其中有隐情。
可是，到底是什么呢？
林馨儿百思不得其解。
等敬茶时，各个长辈都有见面礼，连姐妹都送了见面礼，林馨儿收礼收的手软，真是胆战心惊！
人生，可不可以别这么完美？
她感觉自己消受不起呀！
就好像在前世用信用卡买东西，事后都要还的。
从前的林馨儿有多欢乐，现在的梁心铭就有多痛苦和仇恨，两者成正比，面对王亨，她用尽全身力气克制自己。
一般人紧张或者激动时，总不由自主攥紧拳头；梁心铭为了不让人看破自己的内心，故意撒开两手，可是这没有用，她垂在身侧的手掌依然在微微颤抖。

王亨看见梁心铭，同样浑身一震，双目亮得吓人，眼中惊雷滚滚，身子原本坐得有些散漫，这时也坐正了，把上身微微前倾，紧紧盯着梁心铭，喃喃道：“馨儿……”
众人见他一见梁心铭就变脸，都奇怪。
吴知府则自以为清楚内情，很得意，刚要说话，王亨已然回神，又盯了梁心铭一眼，才颓然放松，往后一靠。
他一直不相信林馨儿死了，可即便馨儿还活着，女大十八变，再变也变不成男人！若在其他场合，他或许会怀疑梁心铭女扮男装；但梁心铭是乡试的秀才，刚得了解元，明年还要参加春闱，谁敢女扮男装参加科举？
“你就是梁心铭？”他声如玉石，只是懒懒的。
“正是。门生见过座师。”梁心铭强行摒除一切杂念，坦然上前，躬身见礼，温润如常。
“且慢，别急着认‘座师’。”吴知府皮笑肉不笑道，言下之意你还不知有没有资格得解元、叫座师呢。
梁心铭并不反驳，也不询问，就站在那。
吴知府对王亨抱拳道：“王翰林，梁秀才这解元的功名恐怕作不得数。他在命案中的嫌疑尚未洗清。当日为他作证的人又想起一些新东西；还有豆腐西施，也有隐情……”
王亨道：“哦？这个本官可要查清楚，否则无法向皇上交代——”吴知府兴奋极了，正要说“正是如此！”就听王亨下面又说道——“那就劳烦大人带本官去命案现场查看一番，到底怎么回事。”说完起身，招呼众人，“大家都去，好做个见证。你也去！”他拿手一指梁心铭。
梁心铭躬身应道：“是。”
吴知府愕然，不是该唤证人上堂吗？
只要证人上堂，把新的证词供认出来，就能推翻梁心铭无罪的结论，给她定罪。为何不传证人，反而要去看现场？都过了这么多天了，案发现场还有什么可看的？
之前他向王亨暗示，王亨并没有异议啊！
吴知府不知王亨葫芦里卖的什么药，很不甘心。
最后，想到那第二名的孟无澜也算是王亨的表兄，和他关系非同一般，吴知府胆子大了些，壮胆道：“安泰贤侄！”
王亨猛回头，冷冷地瞅着他，道：“怎么，大人觉得本官不该去查看？”抬手指着梁心铭，“他可是本科解元！大人说他杀人，本官身为徽州主考官，不该弄个明白？”

content_en:
Unexpectedly, the old lady and Mrs. Wang were overjoyed after hearing Wang Heng's words.
Before Lin Xiner even served tea, she was held in the arms of the old lady. She was loving and affectionate in every way, and said to everyone: "I liked this little appearance as soon as I saw it."
Mrs. Wang also gently asked Lin Xiner whether she was used to it, whether she missed home, etc. She also said that she had stayed up all night with Wang Heng and would go back later to catch up on her sleep so that she wouldn't be tired. She also asked her what she liked to eat and play, and asked the waiter to give her instructions: Just make the food according to the taste that the young lady likes. The young lady is young, so she is not allowed to restrain her, etc.
The brothers and sisters also gathered around Lin Xiner to ask questions, which was very novel.
Lin Xiner thought she had some discernment, but no matter how she looked at them, they didn't seem to be hypocritical and perfunctory. Their eyes were full of kindness and laughter, and she was very confused in her heart: Is she really so lucky? In her previous life, God was jealous of her talents, but in this life, God will compensate her?
Wang Heng showed off happily: "Grandma, Xin'er is so smart!"
Lin Xiner thought that she was a child now and had to be more straightforward, so she said calmly: "I am the smartest in our village. I didn't expect you to be smarter. Oh, how sad!"
Everyone was stunned for a moment, then burst into laughter.
The old lady hugged Lin Xiner and burst into tears with laughter, and said to Mrs. Wang and others: "Seeing that they are getting along well, I feel relieved."
Mrs. Wang lightly tested the corner of her eyes with a handkerchief, and said with emotion: "The old lady is right. As long as they love each other, I can leave immediately and rest in peace."
It's definitely not right!
Lin Xiner keenly sensed that there was something hidden in this.
But what is it?
Lin Xiner was puzzled.
When the tea was served, every elder had a greeting gift. Even the sisters gave gifts. Lin Xiner accepted the gift with a soft hand. She was really frightened!
Can life not be so perfect?
She felt like she couldn't bear it!
It's like buying something with a credit card in a previous life and having to pay it back afterwards.
As happy as Lin Xiner was in the past, Liang Xinming was in pain and hatred now. The two were directly proportional. Facing Wang Heng, she used all her strength to restrain herself.
Most people would involuntarily clench their fists when they were nervous or excited; Liang Xinming deliberately let go of her hands in order to prevent others from seeing through her heart, but it was no use. Her palms hanging by her sides were still trembling slightly.
When Wang Heng saw Liang Xinming, he was also shocked, his eyes were frighteningly bright, and thunder was rolling in his eyes. He was sitting a little sloppily, but now he sat up straight, leaned his upper body slightly forward, stared at Liang Xinming closely, and murmured: "Xin'er..."
Everyone was surprised to see his face change when he saw Liang Xinming.
Magistrate Wu thought he knew the inside story and was very proud. Just as he was about to speak, Wang Heng came to his senses and stared at Liang Xinming again before relaxing and leaning back.
He never believed that Lin Xiner was dead, but even if Xiner was still alive, she would never become a man even if she changed her age. On other occasions, he might suspect Liang Xinming of dressing up as a man; but Liang Xinming was a scholar in the provincial examination, had just learned about the Yuan Dynasty, and would participate in the Spring Festival next year. Who would dare to dress up as a man and participate in the imperial examination?
"Are you Liang Xinming?" His voice was like jade, but he was lazy.
"Exactly. The disciple has met his master." Liang Xinming forcibly dismissed all distracting thoughts, stepped forward calmly, bowed to greet him, and was as gentle as ever.
"Wait a minute, don't rush to recognize the 'seat master'." Magistrate Wu said with a smile but not a smile. The implication is that you don't know whether you are qualified to be Jieyuan or to be called a seat master.
Liang Xinming didn't refute or ask, he just stood there.
Magistrate Wu clasped his fists at Wang Heng and said, "Wang Hanlin, I'm afraid Liang Xiucai's credit for solving Yuan Dynasty is countless. His suspicion in the murder case has not been cleared yet. The people who testified for him that day thought of something new; there is also a hidden secret..."
Wang Heng said: "Oh? I have to find out this official, otherwise I won't be able to explain to the emperor -" Magistrate Wu was very excited, and was about to say, "That's right!" Then he heard Wang Heng say again - "Then would you please take me to the scene of the murder to find out what happened? After speaking, he stood up and called to everyone, "Everyone, go so that you can bear witness." You go too! "He pointed at Liang Xinming.
Liang Xinming bowed and responded: "Yes. "
Magistrate Wu was stunned. Shouldn't the witnesses be called to court?
As long as the witnesses come to court and give new testimony, they can overturn the conclusion that Liang Xinming is innocent and convict her. Why not call witnesses instead of going to see the scene? It’s been so many days, what else is there to see at the crime scene?
He hinted to Wang Heng before that Wang Heng had no objection!
Magistrate Wu didn't know what kind of medicine Wang Heng was selling in his gourd, and he was very unhappy.
Finally, thinking that the second-placed Meng Wulan could be regarded as Wang Heng’s cousin and had an extraordinary relationship with him, Magistrate Wu became bolder and said boldly: “Nephew An Tai! "
Wang Heng suddenly turned around, looked at him coldly, and said, "Why, sir, do you think I shouldn't go check it out? He raised his hand and pointed at Liang Xinming, "He is an undergraduate in Jie Yuan!" Your Excellency said that he killed someone. As the chief examiner of Huizhou, shouldn't I find out? "
